design_analysis.layout: Three option enclosures above a compact question-to-answer path distinguish configurable resources from data flow. Indexing direction differs from inference direction, making label and arrowhead essential.
design_analysis.grouping: Names inside a category are alternatives, except MedCorp explicitly combines corpus sources per text.
design_analysis.omissions: RRF fusion and snippet concatenation are described in text but not decomposed visually.

transferable_rules: Keep resource construction and query-time flow separately labeled; a single left-to-right convention must not reverse indexing.
Use a separate enclosure for alternatives and a different construct for simultaneous branches.
When expanding this overview, add explicit context assembly only with implementation evidence.
nontransferable_content: Specific corpus coverage, LLM choices, RRF settings and performance cannot populate another study.
Cannot relabel a vector/lexical retriever as GraphRAG without graph construction and graph retrieval evidence.
limitations_and_ambiguities: The figure is intentionally coarse: it cannot resolve fine-grained training/inference interfaces.
Color semantics not declared; copying pink/peach as biomedical/general status would require additional support.
